==About me==
I'm Pepper 29yr old (F) and I love The Wheel of Time series. I am on the 7th Book so far and I can't stop reading them. :)

I relate most with Egwene so far, I always have. She seems as powerful as Rand on the female side of the one power and just as important in her own way. I also love the fact that she and Rand seemed to be promised to each other since childhood, and they ended up realizing that they were not meant to be. I admire her throwing herself in with the Aiel and wise ones and learning to Dream Walk. She is fierce and strong and I think she makes the perfect Amerlyn.  [[File:Egwene.jpg|thumb|left|300px]]
